inclusion_protocol.hybrid_participation: offline, telephone and online routes have equal evidence and response status
inclusion_protocol.compensation_and_affordability_rule: Budget participation time, travel, access support, interpretation and carer/companion costs before recruitment; participation is free and basic public service is never conditional on attendance, payment, membership or data surrender.
accessible_materials: read-aloud, interpretation, tactile/raised-line or seated map review on request
advance issue of materials with breaks and companion participation

vulnerable_group_decision_rights.rights_holder: affected users and their chosen representative or access supporter
vulnerable_group_decision_rights.override_rule: A sponsor, supplier or facilitator cannot override an unresolved affected-user safety or rights stop; reopening requires published corrective evidence and renewed affected-user review.

inclusion_protocol.conflict_disclosure: Facilitators, authors, sponsor/site roles, suppliers and reviewers disclose interests before evidence review; material conflicts trigger recusal and are recorded in the published decision log.
inclusion_protocol.complaints: Accept staffed, telephone, paper and optional digital complaints without requiring the disputed system; acknowledge, assign an independent review role, publish the route and preserve appeal and anti-retaliation protections.
inclusion_protocol.output_publication: Publish the method, recruitment target and gaps, accessible anonymised evidence, accepted/rejected/deferred changes with reasons, dissent, conflicts, decision and next gate; never imply that a planned session occurred.
inclusion_protocol.accessible_route_audit: planned_not_run; the current M-carrier drawing is a concept and not a field audit or certification
language_rules: do not hide risk in image-only text
inclusion_protocol.appeal: staffed, telephone, paper and voluntary digital channels
inclusion_protocol.human_channel: required throughout public opening hours; real staffing agreement and service level remain pending
inclusion_protocol.evidence_boundary: No attendance, participant quotation, vote, resident approval, field result, authorization or accessibility certification is claimed.

human_precision_rules.qualifier: not official survey, redline or approval precision

origin_life_iteration.limitation: synthetic tabletop evidence only; not a field test, approval, procurement decision, or operator commitment

source_use_rules.formal: may support a bounded claim with precise marker
source_use_rules.background_only: context only; cannot support site or approval fact
source_use_rules.provisional_only: intake, offline visualisation and recalculation only; must carry provisional warning
source_use_rules.needs_review: not used for substantive claim until cleared

non_commitments: no FAR, height, demolition, engineering or investment conclusion
no legal trademark or accessibility certification

future_test_ladder.name: synthetic rule tabletop
future_test_ladder.evidence: simulation.json contains 72 synthetic contract checks; this is not user, algorithm, accessibility or field performance.
future_test_ladder.result: 12 structurally qualified and 60 blocked synthetic cases; non-empirical only
future_test_ladder.release_gate: No release beyond tabletop on this evidence alone.

future_test_ladder.name: user comprehension and same-task human-route test
future_test_ladder.required_authorization: approved protocol, accessible recruitment, compensation, consent and independent facilitation
future_test_ladder.minimum_evidence: task completion, comprehension, withdrawal, dissent and subgroup gap records
future_test_ladder.release_gate: No expansion if the human route is unavailable or affected users cannot understand and exit.

future_test_ladder.name: professional accessibility and route audit
future_test_ladder.required_authorization: site access, verified geometry and qualified accessibility review
future_test_ladder.minimum_evidence: field route, obstruction, reach, contrast, tactile, hearing and staffed-service findings
future_test_ladder.release_gate: Unresolved safety or access barrier blocks release; no certification is inferred.

future_test_ladder.name: algorithm and supplier evaluation
future_test_ladder.required_authorization: named system, version, lawful data, security review, benchmark and incident owner
future_test_ladder.minimum_evidence: accuracy, subgroup difference, abstention, fallback, drift, version and audit results
future_test_ladder.release_gate: Unknown model/version, unacceptable subgroup harm or failed fallback blocks deployment.

future_test_ladder.name: time-limited reversible field pilot
future_test_ladder.required_authorization: site, operator, fire, structure, utilities, heritage, insurance, funding and public-interest approvals
future_test_ladder.minimum_evidence: opening log, incidents, maintenance, service outcomes, appeals, cost, deletion, removal and restoration receipts
future_test_ladder.release_gate: Default to stop and restore if an evidence gate fails; pilot success never triggers automatic procurement.
